## Contribution rules for cortexproject/cortex

- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L27)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L35)
- A human must write issues; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L35)
- Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`) with the human's name and email, never the agent's. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L29)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L23)
- Review and verify AI output yourself before asking for review. (https://github.com/cortexproject/cortex/blob/HEAD/GENAI_POLICY.md#L25)
